chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Urwah ibn 'Uthman, from Ali ibn 'Isa, raising it, said:

Among what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, whispered to Musa (peace be upon him), was: 'O Musa! Do not lengthen your hope in the world, lest your heart become hard, and the one of the hard heart is remote from Me.'

key_terms.الْقَاسِي الْقَلْبِ: the one of the hard heart

ai.seo_question: What causes the heart to become hard according to the divine whisper to Musa?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the spiritual danger of prolonged worldly expectation (amal (hope/anticipation), which causes the heart to become calloused and distant from the Divine. In Shia tradition, this serves as a practical guide for cultivating *zuhd* (asceticism) not by rejecting the world, but by preventing attachment from hardening the heart, ensuring it remains receptive to Allah's presence.
